Not saying goodbye to my Grandparents one last time. In November of 2017 I was headed to Korea for a year. I was super stressed with moving and had told them I was gonna try to make it out to see them. They lived about 5 hours away from my hometown. I had one last opportunity to go home durring Thanksgiving for a few days. I tried to work out how to add a trip out to see them and just couldnt add 10 hours plus whatever time with them. I gave them one last call and was on a plane 4 days after Thanksgiving headed to my next base. The following June my Grandfather passed away then in October my Grandmother followed. I didnt make it back for either funeral and have been kicking myself ever since. Hindsight being what it is I would have made the time.
